source.text:
お世話になっております。

先週は更新版のご提案書をお送りいただき、ありがとうございました。
取締役 2 名がその週に出張となるため、経営陣によるレビューは 10 月 2 日の予定から 10 月 9 日に延期になりました。
事前資料に含めたいので、改訂後の価格表を 9 月 30 日までにお送りいただけますでしょうか。
また、レポートダッシュボードの 15 分ほどのデモも議題に加えたいと考えております。
この日程でご都合が合うかどうか、お知らせください。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

capture.label: Summarize
capture.instructions: Summarize the input to its essence in one short sentence, in {{ locale | language_name }}; output only the summary, no preamble.

vars.window_title: 提案書の更新とレビュー日程について

turns.reply: The client has postponed the management review to October 9th and requested a revised price list by September 30th, alongside a short demo of the dashboard.

The email you received is a polite request to change a business schedule.

Think of this like moving a meeting to show your work to a group of bosses. Because some of the bosses are away on a trip, the date to look at your proposal has been moved from October 2 to October 9.

Here is what the sender is asking for:

First, they want a new list of prices. They need this by September 30 so they can give it to the bosses to look at before the meeting.

Second, they want you to show them how your computer program works. They call this a "demo," which is just a short live look at the program's features. They want to spend about 15 minutes on this during the meeting.

Finally, they are asking if you are free to meet on this new date of October 9. They want you to tell them if this works for you or if you need to pick a different time.

The person who sent you this email is rescheduling a meeting to review your proposal. 

Because two bosses are away on business, the meeting date is moving from October 2 to October 9. They have three requests for you:

1. Send an updated price list by September 30 so they can review it before the meeting.
2. Include a 15-minute live demonstration of your report dashboard during the meeting.
3. Confirm if you are available to meet on the new date of October 9. 

In short, they are asking for new paperwork and a time check for the rescheduled meeting.

| Item | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Topic** | Update on proposal review schedule |
| **New Review Date** | October 9th |
| **Required Item** | Revised price list |
| **Deadline for Price List** | September 30th |
| **Additional Request** | 15-minute demo of the report dashboard |
| **Action Required** | Confirm availability for the new date |
